diagram:
flowchart TD
  TRIG["▶ On-demand (symbol page)"] --> BUNDLE["📦 Data bundle\nquote · our signal scores · macro regime"]
  BUNDLE --> A1["📈 Market/Technical"]
  BUNDLE --> A2["💬 Sentiment/News"]
  BUNDLE --> A3["📊 Fundamentals"]
  BUNDLE --> A4["🌐 Macro"]
  A1 --> BULL["🐂 Bull advocate"]
  A2 --> BULL
  A3 --> BULL
  A4 --> BULL
  A1 --> BEAR["🐻 Bear advocate"]
  A2 --> BEAR
  A3 --> BEAR
  A4 --> BEAR
  BULL --> EVAL["⚖️ Research Evaluator\n(deepseek-reasoner)"]
  BEAR --> EVAL
  EVAL --> RISK["🛡️ Risk desk\nRisky / Neutral / Safe"]
  RISK --> PM["🎯 Portfolio Manager\nVERDICT + conviction"]
  PM --> STORE["💾 deep_analyses\nadvisory only — risk gate still governs"]

TRIG.label: On-demand
TRIG.description: Runs only when the user clicks 'Run Deep Analysis' on a symbol page. Never on a cron — cost control (~$0.004/run).
TRIG.addReason: Deep multi-agent debate is valuable but costs LLM calls; on-demand keeps it cheap.

BUNDLE.label: Data bundle
BUNDLE.description: Assembles from data we already have: live quote (Massive) + our own agent_signals dimension scores + current macro regime + holding status. Uses zero Alpha Vantage budget (free tier is 25/day).
BUNDLE.addReason: Reasoning over our own numbers avoids external API cost and reuses the system's scoring.

A1.label: Market/Technical analyst
A1.description: One of four parallel analysts (deepseek-chat). Assesses price action, momentum, technical posture; states one bull + one bear technical point.
A1.addReason: Structured multi-lens analysis before the debate.

A2.label: Sentiment/News analyst
A2.description: Parallel analyst — sentiment picture and what would shift it.

A3.label: Fundamentals analyst
A3.description: Parallel analyst — core bull thesis and main fundamental risk.

A4.label: Macro analyst
A4.description: Parallel analyst — is the current regime a tailwind or headwind for this name/sector.

BULL.label: Bull advocate
BULL.description: Builds the strongest evidence-based case to BUY, citing the analyst reports (deepseek-chat).
BULL.addReason: Adversarial debate surfaces both sides better than a single score.

BEAR.label: Bear advocate
BEAR.description: Builds the strongest evidence-based case to AVOID/SELL, focusing on real risks.
BEAR.addReason: The counter-case is where blind spots surface.

EVAL.label: Research Evaluator
EVAL.description: Weighs bull vs bear on deepseek-reasoner, states a lean (Bullish/Bearish/Neutral) with the single most decisive factor.
EVAL.addReason: A neutral judge prevents either advocate from dominating.

RISK.label: Risk desk
RISK.description: Three perspectives — Risky / Neutral / Safe — plus the one key risk to watch.
RISK.addReason: Mirrors a real desk's risk debate.

PM.label: Portfolio Manager
PM.description: Final verdict on deepseek-reasoner: BUY/HOLD/SELL/PASS + conviction 0-100 + rationale. Long-only enforced — an unheld name is BUY or PASS (never SELL).
PM.addReason: One accountable decision-maker synthesizes the debate.

STORE.label: deep_analyses
STORE.description: Stored per symbol with all agent reports. ADVISORY ONLY — it may flag conviction but the deterministic risk gate and approval-required order flow remain authoritative.
STORE.addReason: Governance: an LLM debate advises, it does not execute.

history.label: Deep-Dive
history.reason: Phase 1: adversarial per-symbol debate (closes competitive gap vs trading-agents.ai)
